title: NECO Financial Accounting Part 2: Partnerships, Companies & the Financial System - Financial Accounting - Hire Purchase Accounts
exam: NECO Financial Accounting Part 2: Partnerships, Companies & the Financial System
subject: Financial Accounting

questions.q: A manufacturing machine with a cash price of ₦80,000 is acquired under a hire purchase agreement. An initial deposit of ₦20,000 is paid upon delivery, followed by 12 monthly installments of ₦6,000 each. What is the total **hire purchase interest (finance charge)**?
questions.explain:
1.  **Total Installments Paid:** $12 \times ₦6,000 = ₦72,000$
2.  **Total Hire Purchase Price:** $\text{Deposit} + \text{Total Installments} = ₦20,000 + ₦72,000 = ₦92,000$
3.  **Hire Purchase Interest:**
    $$\text{HP Interest} = \text{Total HP Price} - \text{Cash Price}$$
    $$\text{HP Interest} = ₦92,000 - ₦80,000 = ₦12,000$$
